alana_marketing: Urgent  our Thursday benchmark webinar (showing eu-west latency wins) is in 36h. There's an ongoing eu-west incident and it may impact the live demo. Need status copy, webinar postponement wording, and rules for routing incoming demo requests. Thoughts?

omar_sre: We're still investigating increased tail latency and request errors in eu-west. Could be intermittent for the next few hours. Recommend we do a precautionary delay of any live demos dependent on eu-west, post an "Investigating" on status now.

rhea_product: If we delay, we should offer the benchmark recording + a follow-up live Q&A in 48h. Avoid saying the webinar is "cancelled"; call it postponed and give options.

matt_sales: For inbound leads from the webinar landing page, mark them as "webinar-impact" and route to AEs immediately. Offer a private walkthrough (Dedicated environment) for prospects worried about stability.

jo_support: I'll create a CS playbook: targeted email to registered attendees if we postpone, include ticket placeholder and links to the recorded benchmarks. Also prepare a priority support checkbox for enterprise registrants.

alana_marketing: Draft status + webinar notice options please. Keep public status minimal and separate from webinar comms.

omar_sre: Status blurb:
```
Investigating: We are investigating degraded inference performance in eu-west that may affect live demos and low-latency workloads. Updates: https://status.redwood.ai. No data loss observed.
```

rhea_product: Webinar postponement draft (short):
```
Update: Due to ongoing infrastructure issues in eu-west, we're postponing the live benchmark webinar scheduled for Thursday. Registered attendees will receive the pre-recorded benchmark video and an invitation to a live Q&A.
New live Q&A slot: TBD within 48 hours. We apologize for the inconvenience.
```

matt_sales: Email snippet for registrants (personalized):
```
Subject: Update on Thursday's Redwood benchmark webinar

Hi <FirstName>,

We're postponing the live portion of Thursday's webinar due to a regional incident that could affect the demo. We'll send the benchmark recording now and follow up with a live Q&A invite in ~48 hours. If you'd like an immediate private walkthrough or Dedicated trial, reply and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
The Redwood Events Team
```

jo_support: CS timing: send the recording immediately, targeted postponement email within 30m, AEs notified for registrants with >$2k MRR. Mark demo requests from the landing page as priority and route to sales inbox.

alana_marketing: OK final plan: post the Investigating line on status now, publish a short in-product banner linking to the recording, send targeted emails to registrants (recording + postpone notice), and route inbound demo leads as high priority. We'll publish a recovery/update message and confirm new Q&A time within 48h. I'll draft all copy and schedule sends.

webhookbot: Incident INC-2026-999 created by omar_sre at 1977777799.

alana_marketing: Thanks everyone. I'll post the status and queue the registrant emails in 5 minutes.
